faq_heading: Panorama Ridge condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Panorama Ridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Panorama Ridge, Surrey: 27 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 9 of 15 Surrey communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Panorama Ridge fell from 34 in June to 27 in September (−20.6%), and 22 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 1.8% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Panorama Ridge?
Panorama Ridge also had 101 houses listed and 5 sold in September, against 27 condos and townhomes listed. The Panorama Ridge houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

38 townhomes sold in Panorama Ridge with a median price of $800,000 (the middle half sold between $752,500 and $854,375), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 97.5% of the last list price; 13% sold above list. They had a median $444 per square foot, a median year built of 2004 and a median strata fee of $450 a month.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 27 condos and townhomes listed in Panorama Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Panorama Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Panorama Ridge had a sales ratio of 19%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Panorama Ridge from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 22 condos and townhomes sold in Panorama Ridge over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Panorama Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 38 townhomes sold in Panorama Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $800,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.5% of the last list price (13% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
